sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the instruction-tuned nominal 72B Qwen model; documents text, image and video inputs, text generation, visual reasoning, document understanding and tool-directed visual agents.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL release announcement
sources.evidence: January 26, 2025 announcement explicitly releases Qwen2.5-VL and names Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct. The subsequent Hugging Face repository creation date is January 27, not the announcement date.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint model configuration
sources.evidence: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration: dense 80-layer language decoder, 8192 hidden dimension, 64 attention heads/8 KV heads, and 32-layer vision transformer. max_position_embeddings is 128000.

sources.title: Qwen License Agreement
sources.evidence: Custom Qwen license, including commercial permission condition above 100 million monthly active users. Its September 2024 license date is not this model release date.

sources.title: Checkpoint index and referenced Safetensors headers
sources.evidence: Independently read only the first 65536 bytes of each of the 38 referenced shards. All 1353 tensor shapes total 73410777344 BF16 parameters: 72706203648 language-model parameters and 704573696 visual-encoder/merger parameters. This agrees with index total_size 146821554688 bytes divided by two.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: model_max_length is 131072, conflicting with model config 128000. Template handles image/video/text and has no separate thinking-mode switch; tool-call tokens are present.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL Technical Report
sources.evidence: Section 2.1 and Table 1 describe the 72B variant as Qwen2.5 language decoder, vision transformer and MLP merger; no expert routing. General reasoning and tool-use abilities are described, without defining a separate reasoning-mode capability.

name.note: Display spelling represents the exact official Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct identifier.

family.note: Qwen2.5-VL belongs to the Qwen family.

release_date.note: Official announcement explicitly names this variant; distinguish repository creation the next day.

license.note: Custom Qwen License Agreement; not Apache-2.0.

parameters_b.note: Exact full checkpoint tensor count in decimal billions, including visual encoder and merger. 72B is the nominal variant label, not the exact multimodal total.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active-parameter count. Do not equate total with active: visual processing and language decoding use different components.

architecture.note: Dense decoder plus ViT and MLP merger, corroborated by tensor inventory; no MoE expert/router tensors.

context_window.note: Primary files disagree: model max_position_embeddings=128000, tokenizer model_max_length=131072. No single exact effective context limit is established; preserve both values as an unresolved conflict.

modalities.note: Official examples explicitly support video as well as image and text.

reasoning.note: General visual reasoning is documented, but that does not establish a dedicated thinking/reasoning mode. Neither a definitive true nor false mode flag was verified.

tool_call.note: Developer explicitly describes dynamic tool use; exact tokenizer includes tool-call tokens. Serving integration may require its own tool prompt/template.

description.value: Qwen vision-language model for visual reasoning, documents, and agent tasks
description.note: Supported capability summary, without an unsupported superiority claim.

patch.notes: 72B is the nominal model label; the full published BF16 checkpoint contains 73.410777344B parameters, including 0.704573696B in the visual encoder and merger. Active parameters are not separately defined. Context remains unresolved: model configuration specifies 128000 while the tokenizer specifies 131072. General visual reasoning is documented, but a dedicated reasoning-mode boolean is unverified.

sources.label: Checkpoint index and referenced Safetensors headers

summary: Verified exact full-checkpoint size 73.410777344B versus nominal 72B; added dense architecture, custom Qwen license and video input. Release date and description confirmed. Active size remains undisclosed; exact context and reasoning-mode flag remain unresolved.
